hero.title: Manage every olive field, task, and season in one place
hero.subtitle: Plan field work, assign tasks to producers, track crop-cycle activity, and keep a clear history for every olive grove. Built for olive field owners and producers.

product.title: What is OliveCycle?
product.text: OliveCycle is a web and mobile platform for olive field management. It helps owners and producers organize fields, seasonal tasks, crop-cycle stages, activity history, and basic expenses from one clear system.
product.fieldsText: Create and manage every olive field in one place.
product.tasksText: Plan pruning, fertilization, irrigation, spraying, harvesting, and inspections.
product.historyText: Keep a clean record of completed work, dates, notes, and responsible people.

pain.title: Olive field work is still managed through memory, notebooks, and phone calls
pain.forgottenText: Important seasonal work can be missed or completed too late.
pain.visibilityText: Owners often do not know what happened in each field or when.
pain.clarityText: Workers need simple daily instructions, not complicated software.
pain.scatteredText: When records are split across paper, phone calls, and messages, it is hard to review past work.

features.title: Everything you need to organize olive field work
features.fieldMgmtText: Add field details, location, size, notes, and status.
features.lifecycleText: Track each olive field through seasonal lifecycle stages.
features.calendarText: See upcoming work by day, week, field, or producer.
features.assignmentsText: Assign tasks to producers and monitor progress.
features.activityText: Keep a record of completed work per field and season.
features.expensesText: Track simple field-related costs and connect them to field activity.

web.title: Plan and monitor everything from the web dashboard
web.text: Owners and managers can use the web platform to manage fields, review upcoming tasks, assign work, and understand what needs attention across all olive groves.
web.dashboardDesc: Overview of fields, tasks, activity, and crop-cycle status.
web.calendarDesc: A weekly and monthly view for planning field work.
web.fieldsDesc: One field page with lifecycle stage, upcoming tasks, history, and expenses.
web.historyDesc: A log of what happened, when, and by whom.

mobile.title: Built for field work on mobile
mobile.text: The Android app helps producers see assigned tasks, update progress, and record field activity directly from the field.
mobile.todayText: A simple list of assigned work.
mobile.detailText: Instructions, field name, due date, and complete button.
mobile.activityText: Recent work and notes for a specific field.
mobile.note: Android alpha only. iOS support may come later.

audience.title: Built for both field owners and producers
audience.ownerTitle: Stay in control of every olive grove
ownerBenefits: See all fields in one dashboard
audience.producerTitle: Know exactly what needs to be done today

steps.title: Start managing your olive fields in 3 steps
steps.step1Text: Create your olive fields and basic details.
steps.step2Text: Create seasonal tasks and organize work across the crop cycle.
steps.step3Text: Assign tasks, update progress, and keep activity history.

pricing.title: Alpha access is free for early testers
pricing.subtitle: We are opening OliveCycle to selected olive field owners, producers, and small teams. During alpha, access is free in exchange for feedback. Paid plans will be introduced later.
pricing.ownerFor: Field owners managing multiple olive groves

alpha.title: Download the Android Alpha
alpha.text: Try the first Android alpha version of OliveCycle. This build is intended for testing real olive field workflows and collecting feedback before the official release.
installSteps: Download the APK to your Android phone.
If Android asks, allow installation from this source.
Create an account or log in.
Send feedback after testing real workflows.
alpha.safety: This APK is an alpha build. Install it only from the official OliveCycle website. Some features may change before release.
alpha.dataWarning: During alpha, some test data may be reset as we improve the platform. We will notify testers before major changes.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. OliveCycle is free during the alpha period for selected testers.
faq.q2: Is OliveCycle only for olive fields?
faq.a2: The first version is focused on olive cultivation so the workflow can be specific and useful.
faq.q3: Can producers use it from mobile?
faq.a3: Yes. Producers can use the Android app to view assigned tasks and update work from the field.
faq.a4: Yes. Owners and managers can use the web dashboard for planning, monitoring, and reviewing field activity.
faq.q5: Is the app available in Greek?
faq.a5: Greek is supported as a primary language for the first market. English is also available.
faq.a6: The APK should only be downloaded from the official OliveCycle page. It is an alpha build intended for testing.
faq.q7: Will my data remain after alpha?
faq.a7: During alpha, some test data may be reset as the platform improves. Users should be notified before major changes.
faq.a8: Yes. Use the request demo form or contact us by email.
